reasons: The two answers are almost word-for-word the same. Both open by saying that 10 points cannot be removed and the cap is 6 (第二十五条), and that 10 goes to 4. Both give 6 x 30 = 180 minutes (3 hours) of study plus 6 exams, with 20 questions and a pass mark of 18. Both warn that 4 points is still only 8 short of 12, and that the cap is used up after 6 points. Both note that points clear at the cycle end if fines are paid. Both fail the same way: no 现场学习 or 公益活动 option, no mention that it is free, only part of the 第二十六条 conditions, many unverifiable app and Beijing details, and a length well beyond 'moderate'. A is marginally easier to check because its table shows the minute total (222-330 min) before converting it. B is marginally tighter, with a rounded total. Neither difference separates them, so I call it a tie.
